text:
liz_docs: quick one — spotted an orphaned snippet in console/observability/examples/cost-latency.md. it still references `metrics.cost_per_token` which was renamed in the schema PR last week.
sam_engineering: ah thanks, i saw the failure in the docs CI but couldn't pin it down. do you have the failing lines?
liz_docs: yeah here — snippet in the 'Breakdown by route' block:
```
- metric: metrics.cost_per_token
  transform: average
  label: cost per token
```
should be `metrics.unit_cost` now.
sam_engineering: got it. i'll open a tiny PR to update the snippet and add a comment for backcompat note. running local linkcheck and docs build first.
sam_engineering: command i'm running: `make docs && scripts/linkcheck docs/_build/html` — takes ~30s locally.
toni_prod: quick Q — if we switch to `metrics.unit_cost` do we need to update any screenshots or dashboard exports in the examples folder?
liz_docs: maybe one screenshot in assets/cost-snapshot.png but it's still generic. i checked, numeric labels are the same. only YAML snippet needed changing.
doc-bot: [ci/docs] build failed 1713502499 — reason: `unknown metric 'metrics.cost_per_token'` in console/observability/examples/cost-latency.md
sam_engineering: thanks bot — i'm on it.
sam_engineering: PR: #3289 — updates YAML snippet + adds a 1-line note about the rename. cc @liz_docs for quick review.
liz_docs: looking now. small nits: reword label to `cost per unit` and add inline comment `# old: metrics.cost_per_token` so people know why it changed.
sam_engineering: done and pushed. also added an entry in CHANGELOG.md under docs: "updated cost-latency snippet to use metrics.unit_cost"
doc-bot: [ci/docs] build passed 1713502599 :tada:
toni_prod: nice! can we add a tiny smoke test to catch these YAML metric name regressions in future? maybe a grep in docs CI for known-deprecated-keys.
liz_docs: yes please — created an issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/412 (smokecheck for deprecated metric keys)
sam_engineering: added a follow-up task in the PR description to reference that issue. fine from me to merge once CI is green.
liz_docs: LGTM. merging now. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
sam_engineering: great, thanks — will monitor for any followups in the next release cut.
